profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN. On its own site, Appian describes itself as providing AI automation for critical processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT).

The site presents the Appian Platform as a place where customers build AI-powered processes, with pages covering process automation, artificial intelligence, and legacy application modernization. Appian lists uses including AP, AR, invoice processing, reconciliation, sourcing and contracts, case resolution, purchase-to-pay, onboarding, order fulfillment, and contract review. It says onboarding can be cut by up to 50%. The site also references a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors and an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Its law exposure is recorded in Virginia, with a count of 152.
